question: Who was the Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh, as of January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhupesh Baghel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhupesh Baghel:-**

 
 
• **He is the third Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh, India. **
 
• **As of January 2023, Bhupesh Baghel is the Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh. He has been serving in this position since December 2018.**
 
• He is a member of the Indian National Congress (INC).
 
• He was born on August 23, 1961, in Durg, Chhattisgarh.
 
• He has a Bachelor of Arts degree from Durg College and a Master of Arts degree in Political Science from Ravishankar Shukla University in Raipur.
 
• Baghel began his political career in the 1980s with the Indian Youth Congress.
 
• He was elected to the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly for the first time in 1993.
 
• He served as Minister of Transport in the Madhya Pradesh government from 1999 to 2003.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bhupendra Patel:-**

 
 
• He is a politician from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) who has served as the 17th and current Chief Minister of Gujarat since 2021.
 
• He is a member of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly and has represented the Ghatlodia constituency since 2017.
 
 
 
• **Raman Singh:-**
 
 
• He is a politician from the Indian National Congress (INC) who served as the 13th Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh from 2003 to 2018.
 
• He is a member of the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly and has represented the Jabalpur East constituency since 1984.
 
 
 
• **Ashok Gehlot:-**
 
 
• He is a politician from the INC who has served as the 15th and current Chief Minister of Rajasthan since 2018.
 
• He is a member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly and has represented the Sardarpura constituency since 1998.
